title: Talk about Rosenberg's family and flying with a guitar
summary: Rosenberg talks about flying home and airlines mishandling guitars, with Bunn commiserating.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Have you heard from your wife yet?
Yeah. We were just talking this morning.
Yeah. I'll be going back in a few days.
And you take care of yourself when you do.
I'm going to fly back I think.
I will. I just hope I can get a seat for my guitar.
Sometimes you can sneak the guitar on the plane, you know.
You're supposed to pay half fare for it.
Here's the thing, see, if you put everything in -- you can check it as baggage.
And that doesn't cost anything extra.
But they'll mess it up. They won't take responsibility for it.
So what they've been telling people now is like, you know, buy a seat for it, you know, half fare.

Because that's the best way, because those bags --

-- instead of on like the cart.
